page.layout: One page of verse, set in italic type, with a running head at the top and the page number at the top right. No marginal notes and no footnotes.

l.i: Quā nunc reditum manes, quibus eiulatibu-
Funesta tundes tecta, quum plorans pater
Questus parentum. Te para, supplex Deum
Ne te propinqua mortis horror terreat.
Vis ergo me, Rex Coelitum, iam iam mori,
Adesto praesens, o precor: Sires dato,
Tuis Ut aqua mente iussis obsequar.
Me me paratum cerne, quum Soles, pater,
Palmas liga, ensem stringe, cade, torridis
Adure flammis corpus, haec patiar lubens.
At te, priusquam Caelicolum pater optime,

page.notes: Several words are uncertain in the italic type, notably "Soratum", "Sulnera", "Sires", "Soles" and "Ut", where the letter forms are unclear. The speaker names are set in small capitals and are given as headings. The text ends mid-speech at the foot of the page.
